verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a probe confirming that an official Sentry CLI is documented. A first-party CLI implies the product can be driven headlessly, but nothing in the pack shows CI usage, authentication for automation, or which automation tasks it covers. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration, headless auth tokens for automation, details of CLI automation capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
